    • copyFrom

      public void copyFrom(BuildingRepository other)
      Copies the list of buildings from another BuildingRepository instance to this instance. This operation clears the current list of buildings in this repository and replaces it with a copy of the buildings from the provided repository.
      Parameters:
      other - the BuildingRepository instance from which buildings are copied
